admission.justification: Realized across task_doc_route_review.py, worktrees/memory_verdict_ref.py, roles/reviewer.md, and templates/verdict.md, and proved by three dedicated pytest functions in mcp/tests/test_memory_verdict_ref.py.

applicability: Every memory-lane task_doc record_review call (ordinary and record-only) that supplies a non-null verdictRef.
conditions: Accepted forms are an absolute path to an existing regular file, role-reports/<rel> confined under the bound leaf worktree group, or notes/reports/<rel> existing under the task folder or the bound leaf's role-reports/ directory.
The leaf binding comes from the memory candidate's bound leaf contract (or leaf_enclosure_path for a subTask), never from a series contract.
Invalid, missing, or escaping references refuse with review-verdict-ref-invalid listing the accepted forms and leave the task document unchanged.
exclusions: Memory rounds that omit verdictRef (handled as before and supplying no closeout review fact).
Code review rounds and route reviews, which retain their existing rules.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_memory_verdict_ref.py (tree 0fec81b218c6563f1bfcec58b72b53c8516aee1a; focused pytest -n 0: 50 passed, 14 deselected, 22 subtests passed)

statement: For a memory review round (ordinary or record-only), task_doc record_review refuses any supplied verdictRef that does not name an existing file under one of the three accepted forms (absolute path, role-reports/<rel> under the bound leaf worktree group, or notes/reports/<rel> under the task folder or the leaf's role-reports/), while rounds without verdictRef, code rounds, and route reviews keep their existing rules.
title: Memory record_review validates verdictRef against an existing file
